title: harness node suite red at base: dumb-git-origin under its own 300s rule
body:
harness/test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts fails on every full node-suite run: it flags node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts's 'an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore' (declares timeout 120_000) as process-driving, which the guard requires to declare at least 300_000. Pre-existing at this attempt's base 39c732b6c5b7 — this tick's diff touches neither file — and already carried by open tick 7oy (absorbed finding 25576903…); reported here so the close-out's CI reading of A5 sees it named rather than silent.
evidence: cd harness && pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts fails: 'expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []' naming 'node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts: an origin that outlives the box carries the boot, the wip and the restore'; harness/test/node/dumb-git-origin.test.ts:141 declares { timeout: 120_000 }
demonstrating_check: cd harness && pnpm exec vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts test/node/harness-timeout-discipline.test.ts
